error-credential_scope_provider_mismatch: This provider's API key cannot be used for that purpose.
error-market_data_credential_invalid: The key is invalid or has no credits left, so it was not saved.
error-market_data_credential_check_unava: The key could not be checked with the provider right now, so it was not saved. Try again in a moment.
error-market_data_prices_unconfigured: Data prices are not configured on this deployment, so real competitor resolves and scans cannot be submitted. Controlled Mock still works.
error-market_data_price_operation_missin: The data price table on this deployment lacks {{operations}}, so real competitor resolves and scans cannot be submitted. Controlled Mock still works.
error-market_data_prices_invalid: The data price table on this deployment is malformed, so real competitor resolves and scans cannot be submitted. Controlled Mock still works.
error-competitor_forbidden: Only Workspace members can manage competitors.
error-competitor_archive_forbidden: Only the Owner can archive competitors.
error-competitor_archived: This competitor is archived, so it cannot be resolved or confirmed.
error-competitor_input_required: Paste a page link or type the competitor's name.
error-competitor_name_too_long: A competitor name can have at most {{limit}} characters.
error-competitor_name_required: A website alone cannot be searched. Type the competitor's name and put the site in the website field.
error-competitor_link_unrecognized: This Facebook link does not point to a page. Paste the page link or its Ad Library link.
error-competitor_link_needs_page_id: This link names the page by its alias only. Paste its Ad Library link, or confirm it from a resolve.
error-competitor_website_invalid: Enter the competitor's own website, as a link or a domain such as example.com.
error-competitor_country_invalid: Choose the market as a two-letter country code, such as US.
error-competitor_resolve_needs_name: This competitor was added by page ID only, so there is no name to search. Add it again with its name.
error-competitor_resolution_not_found: This resolve was not found for this competitor.
error-competitor_resolution_not_ready: The resolve has not finished yet. Confirm a page when it has.
error-competitor_resolution_expired: This resolve is older than {{hours}} hours or found no pages. Resolve again to confirm a page.
error-competitor_confirm_target_required: Choose a page from the resolve, or paste a page link.
error-competitor_candidate_not_found: That page is not one of this resolve's candidates.
error-competitor_candidate_deleted: That page has been deleted on Facebook and cannot be confirmed.
error-market_data_credential_missing: Real resolves and scans need the Workspace's ScrapeCreators key. The Owner can add it in Settings; Controlled Mock still works.
error-market_data_credential_unavailable: The Workspace's ScrapeCreators key is no longer available. The Owner can add it again in Settings.
error-market_data_credential_rejected: ScrapeCreators rejected the Workspace's key. The Owner can replace it in Settings.
error-market_data_insufficient_credits: The ScrapeCreators account is out of credits. Top it up, then try again.
error-market_data_rate_limited: ScrapeCreators is limiting requests right now. Try again shortly.
error-market_data_unsupported_country: The data provider does not cover this market.
error-market_data_unreachable: The data provider could not be reached and nothing was charged. Try again.
error-market_data_provider_error: The data provider returned an error ({{provider_code}}).
error-market_data_outcome_unknown: The data provider's answer was lost, so it is unknown whether a credit was charged. Nothing is resent automatically.
error-market_data_turn_busy: Waiting for another resolve or scan that uses the same key.
error-market_data_turn_unavailable: Another resolve or scan kept the ScrapeCreators key busy for too long. Try again.
error-competitor_scan_product_mismatch: One of these competitors belongs to another product. Scan each product's competitors on its own page.
error-competitor_scan_competitor_unconfi: Only competitors with a confirmed page can be scanned. Confirm its page first.
error-competitor_scan_ai_credential_miss: Real scans also need the Workspace's OpenAI key for the AI judgments. The Owner can add it in Settings; Controlled Mock still works.
error-competitor_scan_not_resumable: This scan cannot be resumed now: it is still running, or every page and AI step has finished.
error-competitor_scan_nothing_to_resume: Every page of this scan has been fetched and every AI step has finished. Start a new scan for new data.
error-competitor_scan_reconcile_forbidde: Only the Owner can mark whether a page was charged.
error-competitor_scan_reconcile_not_appl: This page is not waiting to be reconciled.
error-competitor_ad_not_found: This observation was not found in this scan.
error-competitor_discovery_not_found: This scan did not recommend that advertiser.
error-competitor_discovery_already_compe: This advertiser is already on the product's competitor list.
error-competitor_relevance_ids_mismatch: The AI did not judge every observation of a batch, so that batch was left unjudged.
error-competitor_scan_busy: This scan is still running or being reclustered. Try again when it has finished.
error-competitor_scan_nothing_to_cluster: No observation of this scan is relevant, so there is nothing to cluster.
error-competitor_scan_nothing_to_freeze: This scan has no judged observation yet, so there is nothing to freeze.
error-competitor_snapshot_not_found: This competitor snapshot was not found.
error-competitor_tags_unavailable: This scan has no dimension vocabulary to tag against. Set up the product's test-plan dimensions first.
error-competitor_cluster_budget: There are too many observations for this regrouping's budget, so nothing was regrouped.
error-competitor_clusters_items_mismatch: The AI's clustering named observations that are not in this scan, so that clustering was not used.
error-usage_window_invalid: The usage time range is invalid.
error-reporting_context_mismatch: Currency, timezone or attribution differs from the frozen round ({{currency}}, {{timezone}}, {{attribution_window}}).
error-execution_mode_mismatch: Simulation and real delivery cannot be mixed.
error-account_or_binding_missing: Match the Meta account and Ad IDs first.
error-invalid_headers: Headers are missing, repeated or invalid.
error-ambiguous_column_mapping: Several columns could supply this metric ({{columns}}). Choose the exact source column.
error-unknown_mapping_field: The mapped field is not supported.
error-reused_column_mapping: One column cannot supply two different metrics.
error-column_currency_mismatch: This amount column is in {{found}}; the frozen media currency is {{expected}}.
error-required_column_missing: A required metric column is missing.
error-malformed_row: The CSV row has extra or missing columns.
error-row_currency_mismatch: This row is in {{found}}; the frozen media currency is {{expected}}.
error-row_attribution_mismatch: This row uses the {{found}} attribution window; the frozen reporting context uses {{expected}}.
error-unbound_ad: This Ad ID is not matched to an exported creative.
error-outside_round_dates: The date is outside this round ({{start}} to {{end}}).
error-daily_rows_required: Use daily rows, not a date-range total.
error-duplicate_ad_day: The same ad and day appears more than once.
error-missing_value: The required value is empty; unknown is not zero.
error-invalid_nonnegative_number: Enter a finite nonnegative number without currency signs or grouping separators.
error-invalid_csv: The file is not a valid CSV.
error-missing_identifier: Missing a creative code, ad name or ad ID.
error-date_order: The end date is before the start date.
error-future_date: The end date has not arrived yet.
error-not_integer: Impressions and link clicks must be whole numbers.
error-currency_missing: There is spend but no currency. Fill it in the sheet or choose a currency when importing.
error-currency_mismatch: The currency differs from data already imported for this product.
error-unknown_code: This creative code was not found.
error-ambiguous_code: This creative code matches several images. Use the ad ID instead.
error-unknown_ad: No image was found for this ad ID.
error-identifier_conflict: The ad ID and the creative code point to different images.
error-other_product: This image belongs to another product.
error-duplicate_in_file: Duplicates another row in the file.
error-overlaps_in_file: Overlaps the dates of another row in the file.
error-overlaps_existing: Overlaps data already imported (the same image cannot be counted twice).
error-meta_source_unknown: The source of this Meta data cannot be confirmed (no Meta connection is bound).
error-unsupported_export_language: The export package records a language MarketAI does not offer.
